title: Massey-Harris Farm Implements — George McLaughlin's Store
description: Part of farming is having the tools. This is the Massey-Harris farm-implement store, owned and managed by George McLaughlin before the 1907 fire. He promoted efficient farm equipment and techniques.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
rights: Used by permission of Doris Kennedy. Contact the Society for reuse.
